derived.S: 2 + int(ceil(PW/2)>=8 and ceil(PH/2)>=8) + int(ceil(PW/4)>=8 and ceil(PH/4)>=8) + int(ceil(PW/8)>=8 and ceil(PH/8)>=8) + int(ceil(PW/16)>=8 and ceil(PH/16)>=8)

assumptions: Path: metrics/mod.rs:2497-2500 -> run_cpu_native_via_umbrella -> cpu_dispatch.rs:755 -> compute_ssim2 (cpu_dispatch.rs:1300-1314) -> fast_ssim2::compute_ssimulacra2 (sibling fast-ssim2 0.9.0, path dep ../fast-ssim2/fast-ssim2). RGB8_SRGB, no alpha -> compute_encoded_stop -> compute_planar_stop, Kernel::Simd (default; the SIMD lanes run the same logical ops per element, with fusions noted).

Scale count S: NUM_SCALES=6 iterations; level l maps run iff the PREVIOUS level's dims are >=8 on both axes (mod.rs:687-695 gates gw/gh, the pre-downsample dims). Level 0 and 1 always run on >=8px input; l=2 needs ceil(PW/2),ceil(PH/2)>=8, l=3 /4, l=4 /8, l=5 /16. Sub-8px inputs reflect-pad to 8 (PW/PH).

v2 conventions: funnel_copy (row repack) and pad_clone (reflect_padded clone at >=8px) are class 'implementation'. The final iteration's downsample produces level-S output that is never read - split out as downsample_tail (class implementation); downsample covers levels 1..S-1.
v2 conventions: per-level blurs do NOT chain across levels (each blur works inside one level); only downsample chains. blur_h is axis x, blur_v axis y; halo accumulates per axis.
Inline approximations counted as written (v2 conv.1): CubeRootAndAdd's bit-seed + Newton iterations are their arithmetic (mul/fma/add/int), not a 'pow'.

Recursive Gaussian sigma=1.5 -> radius=5 recurrence (create_recursive_gaussian, gauss.rs:39-149; one-time f64 coefficient setup excluded). Effective support radius = 6 (input window n-radius-1 .. n+radius-1, gauss.rs:164-169); the first `radius` iterations produce no output (warm-up) and boundary columns use the bounds-checked scalar_step form - a few-percent effect at eval shapes, not separately counted.

Default SIMD path counted (v2 conv.6): blur_h is 4-way blocked -> per output 3 mul + 10.5 fma + 3 add; the products x1^2/x2^2/x1x2 are counted once as mul_planes (the SIMD path recomputes a*b inside gathers instead of materializing - noted, not double-counted).
blur_h/blur_v are IIR scans: serial=true, span = row/column length; radius=6 is only the nominal direct-input window - true reach is the whole line, conveyed by serial+span.

XYB per pixel (f32): opsin mix 9 fma; 3x CubeRootAndAdd (each: mul 13, fma 6, add/neg 4, int 5 exponent-trick, cmp 1 zero-test, plus the input max(0) cmp) = mul 39, fma 18, add 12, int 15, cmp 6; StoreXYB+MakePositive mul 3, add 6. Totals per pixel: fma 27, mul 42, add 18, int 15, cmp 6, load 3, store 3.

maps_fused (f32 numerators + f64 accumulation) counted as ONE stage: default rayon path runs ssim_map_inner + edge_sums_fast separately per channel (mu1/mu2 loaded twice -> 9 loads/element); the non-rayon fused variant shares them (7 loads). Per element: ssim f32 = mul 5 + add 7 (incl. -dm neg) + fma 1 + div 1; ssim f64 = cvt 1 + add 3 + mul 2 + cmp 1; edge f32 = add 2 + abs 2; edge f64 = cvt 2 + add 8 (incl. -d1 neg) + mul 4 + div 1 + cmp 2.
Final score: 18*S weighted |aggregate| terms + polynomial + powf.

Kernel/config one-time setup (recursive-gaussian coefficients, WEIGHT table, lcms LUT capture) excluded. The Ssimulacra2Reference cached path (score-pairs) does identical per-element work split across set_reference/compare calls.
Alpha absent (RGB8_SRGB) -> single evaluation; has_alpha would run the whole planar pipeline twice (bg 0.1/0.9) and take min.
bytes_* = compulsory traffic (input planes read once, output written once); per-tap stencil reads are only in 'load'.

Sibling rule: counted revision is the CI-pinned fast-ssim2 54fabca9 (snap/work/fast-ssim2), not local 99b98cb9. Diff of the two on the counted score path: additive spatial-maps API (scale_maps_stop, compare_*_maps, pick_alpha_maps) + mechanical magetypes-0.9.30 renames in simd.rs (splat->splat_t, mul_add->mul_add_portable, ...); gauss.rs/xyb.rs identical. No arithmetic change.

Products fuse into the blur input read on the counted Kernel::Simd path: blur_channel(a, Some(b)) -> simd::fast_gaussian_simd multiplies during the gather (precompute.rs:489-505,786-798); the scalar path materializes product planes instead (precompute.rs:800-807).

stages.name: input marshal: strided RGB8 rows -> packed Vec<u8>
stages.notes: Rgb8 arm of source::funnel: row-wise extend_from_slice copy, no conversion.

stages.name: reflect_padded(8): clone_shallow memcpy at >=8px
stages.notes: For W,H>=8 reflect_padded returns clone_shallow = full Vec clone (a real 3WH-byte copy per image). Sub-8 inputs take pad_px gather-mirroring instead.

stages.name: sRGB u8 -> linear f32 via captured lcms 256-LUT
stages.notes: Per channel-sample: load u8, LINEAR_LUT_U8[idx] f32 load, store to planar. int = index form. bg/alpha blends unused (no alpha).

stages.name: 2x2 box decimate linear RGB -> pyramid levels 1..S-1
stages.notes: Iteration l produces level l+1: (p00+p01+p10+p11)*0.25; 4 min() edge clamps counted per element as written. Level-S output (last iteration) is unused - see downsample_tail.

stages.name: 2x2 decimate into never-read level S
stages.notes: The NUM_SCALES loop always downsamples after the last scored level; the output plane is dropped.

stages.name: linear RGB -> positive XYB (opsin + CubeRootAndAdd)
stages.notes: Per pixel: 9 opsin fma + 3x cube_root_and_add (mul 13, fma 6, add/neg 4, int 5, cmp 1 + input max cmp) + StoreXYB/MakePositive (mul 3, add 6). Level-0 xyb reads linearize output; deeper levels read the downsample chain - depends_on picks the max path.

stages.name: product planes x1^2, x2^2, x1*x2
stages.notes: 3 products x 3 channels (x1*x1, x2*x2, x1*x2). SIMD path: no product plane materialized - the mul + second-operand load fuse into blur_h's input gather (precompute.rs:489-505 fast_gaussian_simd; scalar fallback materializes them, precompute.rs:800-807 - not the counted path).

stages.name: FastGaussian horizontal IIR pass, 15 planes
stages.notes: 15 = 5 jobs (x1^2, x2^2, x1x2, x1, x2) x 3 channels. Interior 4-unrolled: per output 3 mul + 10.5 fma + 3 add (1 sum-add + 2 combine) + 2 loads + 1 store. IIR serial scan along the row; radius=6 = direct input window (n-radius-1..n+radius-1), true reach is the full row.

stages.name: FastGaussian vertical IIR pass, 15 planes
stages.notes: Per element: sum = in[top]+in[bottom] (2 loads + 1 add); 3 terms x fma(n2,sum, fma(-d1,y_n1,-y_n2)) = 2 fma + 1 neg; combine y1+(y3+y5) = 2 add; 1 store. ~radius warmup iterations per column produce no output (a few % at eval shapes), not counted.

stages.name: SSIMMap + EdgeDiffMap fused, f32 terms -> f64 sums
stages.notes: Per element (3 channels): ssim f32 part mul 5 add 7 fma 1 div 1 (5 loads); ssim f64 accum cvt 1 add 3 mul 2 cmp 1; edge f32 add 2 abs 2 (4 loads, shares m1/m2 in fused path -> default rayon path loads 9 total); edge f64 cvt 2 add 8 mul 4 div 1 cmp 2. Reduction = per-channel sum/sum-of-4th; barrier per level.

stages.name: per-channel L1/L4 normalization
stages.notes: Per channel: opp*s0, sqrt(sqrt(opp*s1)), opp*e0, sqrt(sqrt(opp*e1)), opp*e2, sqrt(sqrt(opp*e3)). div+cvt run once per scale (opp = 1/n), not per channel - 3x overcounted here, negligible.

stages.name: 108-weight accumulation over scales/channels/norms
stages.notes: ssim += WEIGHT[i]*|v| for 3ch x S scales x 2 norms x 3 entries.
